cast.name: 艾莉丝·布拉加 Alice Braga

introduction: "Anchorless" follows August, a 16-year-old boy that lives in Italy who, during a trip to Belém in Brazil, meets Antonio, 17, and falls in love with him. When August returns to Italy, their relationship becomes virtual, but the messages grow increasingly uncertain and flawed. While August feels more isolated and distant, Antonio begins to embrace the carefree nature of youth, attending parties and engaging in new relationships. The story tracks the ups and downs of their bond, marked by jealousy, insecurities, and the challenges of maintaining a long-distance love while both characters navigate their personal transformations.
